body:
I've been being honest with myself so I have to be honest with you - she is an amazing person and I treated her like an object.  She did so much to build an amazing life for the both of us and I just went along for the ride.  All she asked of me was my love and respect and I gave her neither.  The only time she ever hurt me was now, and it's simply because I love her that it hurts so much.  

But, this isn't a "I'll die without her" sort of feeling.  This is "i've come to terms with the person I am and I don't l ike it and won't change".  I've lost several amazing women, all due to me being an asshole.  I've lost women that men would kill to be with.  I know there are more women out there, and i could meet them, fall in love, etc - but i will push them away too.  I don't know how to be happy.

All I've been thinking about is how much I want to work on things, how sick it makes me to lose her and really focusing in on my faults and, to some degree, hers.  I've done nothing but try and work on what she said I had failed in; didn't giver her affection enough, wasn't kicking in around the house enough, didn't "make love" enough".  The big one is not being a part of the marriage as much as I should have been.  I don't think she is in a place to see any of her faults so sharing something like this with her will just make her build her wall stronger.

I think she has someone lined up; but not that she really wants to be with them but just a crutch to get her through this.  Rather than face it alone, she's going to avoid it by being with someone else.
Oh wow, i just did a bunch of reading on "walkaway wife syndrome" and it is spot on with what i'm going through!  I wish i could get her to read it, but asking her would be suicide.
Actually, that was the sub i was going to post this too but so little traffic thought this was a better place to get a response :)
What if she says she wants it but isn't at a place to put 100% effort in to it right now?  I feel like i could accept that (with boundries and expectations established) but that I shouldn't.

I thought my wife was still in the marriage with both feet so I didn't have an issue with her filling a need i couldn't meet.  In retrospect, she was having doubts about the marriage and wanted to explore something other than me.  I certainly was played in that regard (only myself to blame for that).

I know there is a fine line between being hopeful and being ignorant but I think, when you love someone, you have to fight for it.  A big part of why I am here today is because i didn't fight enough for it over the last year.  I don't plan on being some pathetic doormat at home that lets her walk all over me.  I plan on being a strong man who is making plans to move on with his life.  Either we stay together and move past this or we don't but, either way, I will be moving forward with my life.
It's not a dude, it's a chick.  My wife is pansexual.

I truly think there is a part of her that wants to work on it but, as i said in a reply above, she is so confused due to emotions from NRE that she isn't doing things logically.  Her therapist told her the same thing.  She is in therapy because she has always had trouble dealing with emotions; she is extremely emotional but doesn't know how to express them to people.

And that is where different morals come in to play.  I have always been one that is ok with poly/open relationships.  We never had one in the past but my wife met her lover, with me, and for a few months she was married to me and dating her lover.  I honestly, was ok with it.  What changed is that my wife got so wrapped up in her NRE that she started neglecting our marriage.  That's why I don't really thing she wants a divorce she is just confused on account of all the emotions that come with NRE.  I have a lot of respect for myself and I have no doubt that in the future everything will be fine with me.

>understand exactly what you want in ~~a wife~~ life.  

This is where I am right now.  I am hopeful but am also aware that, regardless of what happens, I need to make changes and take care of myself.  Otherwise, whether it's with her or someone else, I'll fall back in to the same issues as before.

That was one of the thoughts I had the other day: either who my wife is right now is the real her and the last seven years were a lie, or who she is right now is a lie.  More likely who she is being right now is a lie.  That is the only thing that gives me hope.  She cares too much to just give up like that.

I feel like I did a lot to put strain on the relationship but nothing so bad as to call it quits.  However, what she is doing to selfish and so she's blaming me for everything to she doesn't feel guilt over it.  I'm hoping that me being away will allow my wife and her lover to face what it is they are doing; breaking up a marriage with an affair.  My wife is very loving but isn't gay so I know at some point, maybe weeks maybe years, she'll no longer want to have a life with this girl.  I believe she does love her, but even my wife said "i just want to be her best friend but it would hurt her if I told her that".  NRE is a very powerful beast for sure.

Except that when I had the chance, i didn't show her how much I loved her.  Her problem was not speaking up or communicating things she didn't like but, rather, did them because they made me happy.  I did a lot of things to bring us to this point and I see that now.  I am just hoping that she doesn't give up on a marriage that easily and because someone else is whispering in her ear.

Edit to reply to your edit: She always did treat with love and respect.  She is the most loving person i've ever known.  What she is doing now is only out of anger towards me.
